quote: The data for the two seasonal samples gave a mean serum lysozyme level of for the sample taken in spring and autumn. Statistical analysis of these two sample sets showed a highly significant difference (p<0.05).
statement: 春季和秋季采集的两个季节性样本的平均血清溶菌酶水平数据显示出高度显著的差异。
text_zh: 春季和秋季采集的两个季节性样本的平均血清溶菌酶水平数据显示出高度显著的差异。
text_en: The average serum lysozyme levels of two seasonal samples collected in spring and autumn showed highly significant differences.

quote: On day 4, fish were anesthetized and dissected, and various tissues, including those of the testis, liver, brain, and heart, were collected.
statement: 在第4天，对鱼进行麻醉和解剖，并收集包括睾丸、肝脏、大脑和心脏在内的各种组织。
text_zh: 在第4天，对鱼进行麻醉和解剖，并收集包括睾丸、肝脏、大脑和心脏在内的各种组织。
text_en: On day 4, the fish were anesthetized and dissected, and various tissues including testes, liver, brain, and heart were collected.

quote: The dietary treatments were (1) basal diet, (2) basal diet + CuSO4 (40 mg kg–1 copper as CuSO4), (3) basal diet + 0.5% silicate, (4) basal diet + 0.5% CLS, (5) basal diet + 50 mg kg–1 CTC (purity 98.8%; Wuhan Hezhongs).
statement: 日粮处理包括：(1)基础日粮，(2)基础日粮+CuSO4（以CuSO4计铜含量40 mg/kg），(3)基础日粮+0.5%硅酸盐，(4)基础日粮+0.5%CLS，(5)基础日粮+50 mg/kg CTC（纯度98.8%）。
text_zh: 日粮处理包括：(1)基础日粮，(2)基础日粮+CuSO4（以CuSO4计铜含量40 mg/kg），(3)基础日粮+0.5%硅酸盐，(4)基础日粮+0.5%CLS，(5)基础日粮+50 mg/kg CTC（纯度98.8%）。
text_en: Dietary treatments included: (1) basal diet, (2) basal diet + CuSO4 (copper content 40 mg/kg as CuSO4), (3) basal diet + 0.5% silicate, (4) basal diet + 0.5% CLS, (5) basal diet + 50 mg/kg CTC (purity 98.8%).

quote: an environment-controlled laboratory maintained at 25°C, with a photoperiod of 12 h light:12 h dark was installed.
statement: 安装了环境控制的实验室，温度维持在25°C，光周期为12小时光照：12小时黑暗。
text_zh: 安装了环境控制的实验室，温度维持在25°C，光周期为12小时光照：12小时黑暗。
text_en: Laboratories equipped with environmental control, where the temperature was maintained at 25°C and the photoperiod was 12 hours light:12 hours dark.

quote: The culture system was also provided with continuous aeration through an air compressor and heaters to keep water temperature at 22 to 25°C.
statement: 养殖系统还通过空气压缩机提供连续曝气，并使用加热器保持水温在22至25°C之间。
text_zh: 养殖系统还通过空气压缩机提供连续曝气，并使用加热器保持水温在22至25°C之间。
text_en: The aquaculture system also provides continuous aeration via an air compressor and uses heaters to maintain water temperature between 22 and 25°C.

quote: Edwards and Twomey (1982), reported that survival in such an environment may require high levels of these natural immunity factors.
statement: Edwards和Twomey（1982）报道，在这种环境中生存可能需要高水平的这些天然免疫因子。
text_zh: Edwards和Twomey（1982）报道，在这种环境中生存可能需要高水平的这些天然免疫因子。
text_en: Edwards and Twomey (1982) reported that survival in this environment may require high levels of these natural immune factors.

quote: However, factors affecting stress in the environmental milieu are gender and maturity, time, nutrition, season, and vital cycle; and that birds living in environmental environment
statement: 然而，影响环境介质中压力的因素包括性别和成熟度、时间、营养、季节和生活周期；以及生活在环境中的鸟类...
text_zh: 然而，影响环境介质中压力的因素包括性别和成熟度、时间、营养、季节和生活周期；以及生活在环境中的鸟类...
text_en: However, factors affecting pressure in environmental media include sex and maturity, time, nutrition, season, and life cycle; as well as birds living in the environment...

quote: Our results showed the relative percent survival was 66.7% in the booster vaccine group, indicating this oral yeast vaccine is a promising vaccine for controlling CyHV-2 disease in gibel carp aquaculture.
statement: 结果显示加强免疫组的相对存活率为66.7%，表明这种口服酵母疫苗是控制银鲫养殖中CyHV-2疾病的有前景的疫苗。
text_zh: 结果显示加强免疫组的相对存活率为66.7%，表明这种口服酵母疫苗是控制银鲫养殖中CyHV-2疾病的有前景的疫苗。
text_en: The results showed that the relative survival rate of the booster immunization group was 66.7%, indicating that this oral yeast vaccine is a promising vaccine for controlling CyHV-2 disease in silver crucian carp farming.

quote: Vaccination has been shown to be the most effective countermeasure against viral infection due to its immunostimulatory effect, thus reducing morbidity and mortality.
statement: 疫苗接种因其免疫刺激作用而被证明是对抗病毒感染最有效的对策，从而降低发病率和死亡率。
text_zh: 疫苗接种因其免疫刺激作用而被证明是对抗病毒感染最有效的对策，从而降低发病率和死亡率。
text_en: Vaccination has been proven to be the most effective countermeasure against viral infections due to its immunostimulatory effect, thereby reducing morbidity and mortality.

quote: our findings provide crucial insights into the role of oral vaccination in combating viral infections in teleost fish.
statement: 研究结果提供了关于口服疫苗在对抗硬骨鱼病毒感染中作用的关键见解。
text_zh: 研究结果提供了关于口服疫苗在对抗硬骨鱼病毒感染中作用的关键见解。
text_en: The results provide key insights into the role of oral vaccination in combating viral infections in teleost fish.

quote: To test the safety of the yeast vaccine, 30 fish were randomly sampled from each of the three groups (i.e., control, vaccine, and booster vaccine) and monitored for cumulative mortality daily for 40 days
statement: 为了测试酵母疫苗的安全性，从对照组、疫苗组和加强免疫组中随机抽取30条鱼，并连续40天监测累积死亡率。
text_zh: 为了测试酵母疫苗的安全性，从对照组、疫苗组和加强免疫组中随机抽取30条鱼，并连续40天监测累积死亡率。
text_en: To test the safety of the yeast vaccine, 30 fish were randomly sampled from the control group, the vaccinated group, and the booster immunization group, and cumulative mortality was monitored for 40 consecutive days.

quote: whereas the other fish were sacrificed at 10, 17, 27, and 34 dpv to collect tissue s
statement: 其余鱼类在接种后第10、17、27和34天被处死以收集组织样本。
text_zh: 其余鱼类在接种后第10、17、27和34天被处死以收集组织样本。
text_en: The remaining fish were euthanized on days 10, 17, 27 and 34 post-vaccination to collect tissue samples.

quote: The mortalities and clinical signs were daily observed in the vaccine and booster vaccine groups for 40 days.
statement: 在疫苗组和加强疫苗组中，连续40天每日观察死亡率和临床症状。
text_zh: 在疫苗组和加强疫苗组中，连续40天每日观察死亡率和临床症状。
text_en: In the vaccine group and booster vaccine group, mortality and clinical symptoms were observed daily for 40 consecutive days.

quote: The length-width ratios of the foregut, midgut, and hindgut intestinal folds were measured for evaluating microscopic pathological changes.
statement: 通过测量前肠、中肠和后肠肠绒毛的长宽比来评估微观病理变化。
text_zh: 通过测量前肠、中肠和后肠肠绒毛的长宽比来评估微观病理变化。
text_en: Microscopic pathological changes were assessed by measuring the length-to-width ratio of intestinal villi in the foregut, midgut, and hindgut.

quote: Complement 3 (C3), total superoxide dismutase (TSOD), and lysozyme (LZM) of serum and gut mucus were assayed by the corresponding commercial kit protocols
statement: 使用商业试剂盒方案检测血清和肠道黏液中的补体3（C3）、总超氧化物歧化酶（TSOD）和溶菌酶（LZM）。
text_zh: 使用商业试剂盒方案检测血清和肠道黏液中的补体3（C3）、总超氧化物歧化酶（TSOD）和溶菌酶（LZM）。
text_en: Complement 3 (C3), total superoxide dismutase (TSOD), and lysozyme (LZM) in serum and intestinal mucus were detected using commercial kit protocols.

quote: No dead fish in the vaccine and booster vaccine groups were monitored during the 40 days after vaccination.
statement: 在疫苗接种后40天内，疫苗组和加强疫苗组未监测到死亡鱼。
text_zh: 在疫苗接种后40天内，疫苗组和加强疫苗组未监测到死亡鱼。
text_en: Within 40 days after vaccination, no dead fish were detected in the vaccine group and the booster vaccine group.

quote: Taken together, the oral yeast vaccine did not cause mortality or clinical symptoms of the gut, which indicates that the vaccine is safe for gibel carp.
statement: 综上所述，口服酵母疫苗未引起死亡率或肠道临床症状，表明该疫苗对银鲫是安全的。
text_zh: 综上所述，口服酵母疫苗未引起死亡率或肠道临床症状，表明该疫苗对银鲫是安全的。
text_en: In summary, oral yeast vaccine did not cause mortality or intestinal clinical symptoms, indicating that the vaccine is safe for silver crucian carp.

quote: Cyprinid herpesvirus 2 (CyHV-2) causes herpesviral hematopoietic necrosis (HVHN) disease outbreaks in farmed Cyprinid fish, which leads to serious economic losses worldwide.
statement: 鲤疱疹病毒2型（CyHV-2）导致养殖鲤科鱼类发生疱疹病毒性造血坏死病爆发，造成严重的经济损失。
text_zh: 鲤疱疹病毒2型（CyHV-2）导致养殖鲤科鱼类发生疱疹病毒性造血坏死病爆发，造成严重的经济损失。
text_en: Cyprinid herpesvirus 2 (CyHV-2) causes outbreaks of herpesviral hematopoietic necrosis in farmed cyprinid fish, resulting in severe economic losses.

quote: Although oral vaccination is considered the most suitable strategy for preventing infectious diseases in farmed fish, so far there is no commercial oral vaccine available for controlling HVNN in gibel carp (C. auratus gibelio).
statement: 尽管口服疫苗被认为是预防养殖鱼类传染病的最合适策略，但目前尚无用于控制银鲫疱疹病毒性造血坏死病的商业口服疫苗。
text_zh: 尽管口服疫苗被认为是预防养殖鱼类传染病的最合适策略，但目前尚无用于控制银鲫疱疹病毒性造血坏死病的商业口服疫苗。
text_en: Although oral vaccines are considered the most suitable strategy for preventing infectious diseases in farmed fish, there is currently no commercial oral vaccine available for controlling herpesviral hematopoietic necrosis disease of gibel carp.

quote: In the present study, we developed for the first time an oral vaccine against CyHV-2 by using yeast cell surface display technology and then investigated the effect of this vaccine in gibel carp.
statement: 本研究首次利用酵母细胞表面展示技术开发了针对CyHV-2的口服疫苗，并研究了该疫苗在银鲫中的效果。
text_zh: 本研究首次利用酵母细胞表面展示技术开发了针对CyHV-2的口服疫苗，并研究了该疫苗在银鲫中的效果。
text_en: This study is the first to use yeast cell surface display technology to develop an oral vaccine against CyHV-2, and investigated the effect of this vaccine in gibel carp.

quote: Moreover, strong innate and adaptive immune responses could be elicited in both mucosal and systemic tissues after receipt of the oral yeast vaccine.
statement: 此外，接受口服酵母疫苗后，黏膜和全身组织均可引发强烈的先天性和适应性免疫反应。
text_zh: 此外，接受口服酵母疫苗后，黏膜和全身组织均可引发强烈的先天性和适应性免疫反应。
text_en: In addition, oral yeast vaccination can trigger strong innate and adaptive immune responses in both mucosal and systemic tissues.

quote: However, the tissue injury in the gut of the Bo-va+Cha group was significantly reduced compared to Con+Cha fish.
statement: 与对照组相比，加强免疫酵母疫苗组在攻毒后的肠道组织损伤显著减轻。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，加强免疫酵母疫苗组在攻毒后的肠道组织损伤显著减轻。
text_en: Compared to the control group, the yeast vaccine booster immunization group showed significantly reduced intestinal tissue damage after challenge.

quote: Therefore, our findings suggested that vaccination with yeast vaccine relieves the gut damage caused by CyHV-2 infection.
statement: 研究结果表明，接种酵母疫苗可缓解由CyHV-2感染引起的肠道损伤。
text_zh: 研究结果表明，接种酵母疫苗可缓解由CyHV-2感染引起的肠道损伤。
text_en: The results indicate that vaccination with yeast vaccine can alleviate intestinal damage caused by CyHV-2 infection.

quote: Here, we prepared an oral vaccine using the yeast surface display system to express the ORF25 gene from CyHV-2 on S. cerevisiae .
statement: 在此，我们使用酵母表面展示系统在酿酒酵母上表达CyHV-2的ORF25基因，制备了一种口服疫苗。
text_zh: 在此，我们使用酵母表面展示系统在酿酒酵母上表达CyHV-2的ORF25基因，制备了一种口服疫苗。
text_en: Here, we used a yeast surface display system to express the ORF25 gene of CyHV-2 on Saccharomyces cerevisiae and prepared an oral vaccine.

quote: After vaccination and booster vaccination of gibel carp, we evaluated the safety and immunogenicity of the oral yeast vaccine by evaluating cumulative mortality, gut histology, body fluid biochemical indices, immune-related gene expression, and pathogen loads.
statement: 在对银鲫进行初免和加强免疫后，我们通过评估累积死亡率、肠道组织学、体液生化指标、免疫相关基因表达和病原体载量来评估口服酵母疫苗的安全性和免疫原性。
text_zh: 在对银鲫进行初免和加强免疫后，我们通过评估累积死亡率、肠道组织学、体液生化指标、免疫相关基因表达和病原体载量来评估口服酵母疫苗的安全性和免疫原性。
text_en: After primary and booster immunization of silver crucian carp, we evaluated the safety and immunogenicity of an oral yeast vaccine by assessing cumulative mortality, intestinal histology, humoral biochemical indicators, immune-related gene expression, and pathogen load.
outcome: 安全性与免疫原性评估

quote: Finally, a challenge test was performed to confirm the protective efficacy of the yeast vaccine against CyHV-2.
statement: 最后，进行了攻毒试验以确认酵母疫苗对CyHV-2的保护效力。
text_zh: 最后，进行了攻毒试验以确认酵母疫苗对CyHV-2的保护效力。
text_en: Finally, a challenge test was conducted to confirm the protective efficacy of the yeast vaccine against CyHV-2.

quote: Taken together, our results indicate that the orally-administered live recombinant yeast vaccine developed herein is a promising candidate for the control of CyHV-2 in the gibel carp farming industry.
statement: 总之，我们的结果表明，此处开发的口服活重组酵母疫苗是控制鲫鱼养殖行业中CyHV-2的一个有希望的候选者。
text_zh: 总之，我们的结果表明，此处开发的口服活重组酵母疫苗是控制鲫鱼养殖行业中CyHV-2的一个有希望的候选者。
text_en: In conclusion, our results indicate that the oral live recombinant yeast vaccine developed here is a promising candidate for controlling CyHV-2 in the crucian carp farming industry.

quote: Unfortunately, most currently available vaccines against CyHV-2 are administered through injection, which is not only stressful to the fish but also labor-intensive and costly, thus limiting their use and promotion (13).
statement: 目前大多数针对CyHV-2的疫苗通过注射给药，这不仅对鱼类造成应激，而且劳动密集且成本高昂，从而限制了其使用和推广。
text_zh: 目前大多数针对CyHV-2的疫苗通过注射给药，这不仅对鱼类造成应激，而且劳动密集且成本高昂，从而限制了其使用和推广。
text_en: Currently, most vaccines against CyHV-2 are administered by injection, which not only causes stress to fish but is also labor-intensive and costly, thereby limiting their use and promotion.

quote: Anal and nasal vaccination have been tested in the laboratory with good results, but their practical application is doubtful because of the associated difficulty of administration (19 , 20).
statement: 肛门和鼻腔接种在实验室中测试取得了良好结果，但由于给药困难，其实际应用令人怀疑。
text_zh: 肛门和鼻腔接种在实验室中测试取得了良好结果，但由于给药困难，其实际应用令人怀疑。
text_en: Rectal and nasal vaccination showed good results in laboratory tests, but its practical application is doubtful due to administration difficulties.

quote: The main concerns for bath immunization remain the large amounts of antigen required and the immunization efficiency.
statement: 浴式免疫的主要担忧仍然是所需抗原量大和免疫效率问题。
text_zh: 浴式免疫的主要担忧仍然是所需抗原量大和免疫效率问题。
text_en: The main concerns regarding bath immunization remain the large amount of antigen required and issues with immunization efficiency.
limitations: 抗原需求量大、免疫效率不确定

quote: Oral vaccination can directly deliver the vaccines to the gut mucosal surface and can stimulate mucosal and systemic immune responses against infections (15).
statement: 口服疫苗可以直接将疫苗递送至肠道黏膜表面，并能刺激针对感染的黏膜和全身免疫反应。
text_zh: 口服疫苗可以直接将疫苗递送至肠道黏膜表面，并能刺激针对感染的黏膜和全身免疫反应。
text_en: Oral vaccines can directly deliver the vaccine to the intestinal mucosal surface and stimulate both mucosal and systemic immune responses against infection.

quote: Moreover, oral vaccines are well suited for fish immunization because they eliminate the need to handle animals and can be easily applied to both small and large sized fish, in addition to being far less labor-intensive than injection (13).
statement: 此外，口服疫苗非常适合鱼类免疫，因为它们消除了处理动物的需要，可以轻松应用于大小不同的鱼类，并且比注射劳动强度低得多。
text_zh: 此外，口服疫苗非常适合鱼类免疫，因为它们消除了处理动物的需要，可以轻松应用于大小不同的鱼类，并且比注射劳动强度低得多。
text_en: In addition, oral vaccines are very suitable for fish immunization because they eliminate the need to handle animals, can be easily applied to fish of different sizes, and are much less labor-intensive than injection.
outcome: 操作便利性与动物福利（减少捕捉应激）

quote: Experimental studies on CyHV-2 vaccines began in 2013 (7), and several vaccines have since been developed and used to prevent and control CyHV-2 infection, including inactivated vaccines, live vaccines, DNA vaccines, and subunit vaccines (7 – 12).
statement: 自2013年开始对CyHV-2疫苗进行实验研究，随后开发并使用了多种疫苗以预防和控制CyHV-2感染，包括灭活疫苗、活疫苗、DNA疫苗和亚单位疫苗。
text_zh: 自2013年开始对CyHV-2疫苗进行实验研究，随后开发并使用了多种疫苗以预防和控制CyHV-2感染，包括灭活疫苗、活疫苗、DNA疫苗和亚单位疫苗。
text_en: Experimental research on CyHV-2 vaccines began in 2013, followed by the development and use of various vaccines to prevent and control CyHV-2 infection, including inactivated vaccines, live vaccines, DNA vaccines, and subunit vaccines.

population.species: 鲤科疱疹病毒2型易感鱼类（隐含）

quote: Particularly, live vaccines are the closest alternative to natural pathogen infection, in addition to being powerful and eliciting durable immune responses (10).
statement: 特别是，活疫苗是最接近自然病原体感染的替代品，此外它们效力强并能引发持久的免疫反应。
text_zh: 特别是，活疫苗是最接近自然病原体感染的替代品，此外它们效力强并能引发持久的免疫反应。
text_en: In particular, live vaccines are the closest substitute to natural pathogen infection; in addition, they are highly effective and can elicit a long-lasting immune response.

quote: However, live attenuated vaccines carry a risk of reverting to their wild-type form and causing disease (14).
statement: 然而，减毒活疫苗存在回复为野生型形式并导致疾病的风险。
text_zh: 然而，减毒活疫苗存在回复为野生型形式并导致疾病的风险。
text_en: However, live attenuated vaccines carry the risk of reverting to wild-type forms and causing disease.

quote: All fish were acclimatized for at least 2 weeks at 25 ± 1°C and fed commercial pellets twice a day before vaccination.
statement: 所有鱼在免疫前在25±1°C下适应至少2周，并每天喂食两次商业颗粒饲料。
text_zh: 所有鱼在免疫前在25±1°C下适应至少2周，并每天喂食两次商业颗粒饲料。
text_en: All fish were acclimated at 25±1°C for at least 2 weeks before immunization and fed commercial pellet feed twice daily.

quote: The yeast vaccine was prepared by mixing the precipitate (6 × 10 -2 CFU g -1) with gibel carp feed with a mass ratio of 1:100.
statement: 酵母疫苗通过将沉淀物与异育银鲫饲料按1:100的质量比混合制备。
text_zh: 酵母疫苗通过将沉淀物与异育银鲫饲料按1:100的质量比混合制备。
text_en: The yeast vaccine was prepared by mixing the precipitate with gibel carp feed at a mass ratio of 1:100.

quote: The water temperature was controlled at 25 ± 1°C during vaccination.
statement: 免疫期间水温控制在25±1°C。
text_zh: 免疫期间水温控制在25±1°C。
text_en: During the immunization period, water temperature was controlled at 25±1°C.

quote: The adaptive immune-related genes were significantly upregulated in the midgut, hindgut, and spleen after vaccination
statement: 接种后，适应性免疫相关基因在中肠、后肠和脾脏中显著上调。
text_zh: 接种后，适应性免疫相关基因在中肠、后肠和脾脏中显著上调。
text_en: After vaccination, adaptive immunity-related genes were significantly upregulated in the midgut, hindgut, and spleen.

quote: Then one group was injected with CyHV-2 stock (100 μl per fish) at the base of the pectoral fin, while the other control group was injected with PBS.
statement: 一组鱼在胸鳍基部注射CyHV-2病毒原液，另一组对照鱼注射PBS。
text_zh: 一组鱼在胸鳍基部注射CyHV-2病毒原液，另一组对照鱼注射PBS。
text_en: One group of fish was injected with CyHV-2 virus stock at the base of the pectoral fin, and another control group was injected with PBS.

quote: Thereafter, at 4 days after challenge (45 dpv), six fish (each group) of these six groups ... were randomly selected and analyzed for pathological changes of gut.
statement: 在攻毒后第4天，从各组随机选取六条鱼分析肠道病理变化。
text_zh: 在攻毒后第4天，从各组随机选取六条鱼分析肠道病理变化。
text_en: On day 4 post-challenge, six fish were randomly selected from each group to analyze intestinal pathological changes.

quote: The clinical signs, cumulative mortality, and survival rates were recorded daily for 30 days post challenge (dpc)
statement: 记录攻毒后30天内每天的临床体征、累积死亡率和存活率。
text_zh: 记录攻毒后30天内每天的临床体征、累积死亡率和存活率。
text_en: Record daily clinical signs, cumulative mortality, and survival rate within 30 days post-challenge.

quote: Before sampling, gibel carp were anesthetized with MS-222 (Tricaine methanesulfonate, Sigma, USA) at a concentration of 100 mg/l.
statement: 采样前，银鲫使用浓度为100毫克/升的MS-222（三卡因甲磺酸盐）进行麻醉。
text_zh: 采样前，银鲫使用浓度为100毫克/升的MS-222（三卡因甲磺酸盐）进行麻醉。
text_en: Before sampling, silver crucian carp were anesthetized with MS-222 (tricaine methanesulfonate) at a concentration of 100 mg/L.

quote: Blood samples were obtained from the caudal vein and were placed at 4°C overnight, after which were centrifuged at 5000 g for 10 min.
statement: 血液样本从尾静脉采集，并在4°C下过夜放置，随后在5000 g下离心10分钟。
text_zh: 血液样本从尾静脉采集，并在4°C下过夜放置，随后在5000 g下离心10分钟。
text_en: Blood samples were collected from the tail vein, left overnight at 4°C, and then centrifuged at 5000 g for 10 minutes.

quote: For intestinal mucus collection, the gut of gibel carp was excised and opened longitudinally.
statement: 为了收集肠道黏液，切除银鲫的肠道并纵向切开。
text_zh: 为了收集肠道黏液，切除银鲫的肠道并纵向切开。
text_en: To collect intestinal mucus, the intestines of silver crucian carp were excised and cut open longitudinally.

quote: Compared to the control group, the C3 activity showed a significant increase in foregut mucus at 10, 17, and 27 dpv, in midgut mucus at 27 and 34 dpv, in hindgut mucus at 17, 27 dpv, and in serum at 10, 17 dpv in the vaccine group.
statement: 与对照组相比，疫苗组在多个时间点和部位（前肠、中肠、后肠黏液及血清）的C3活性显著增加。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，疫苗组在多个时间点和部位（前肠、中肠、后肠黏液及血清）的C3活性显著增加。
text_en: Compared with the control group, C3 activity was significantly increased in the vaccine group at multiple time points and sites (foregut, midgut, hindgut mucus, and serum).

quote: The TSOD activity was significantly higher than that of control fish in the foregut and hindgut mucus at 10 and 17 dpv, in midgut mucus at 10 and 27 dpv, and in serum at 10, 17, and 17 dpv and then returned to normal levels.
statement: TSOD活性在特定时间点的肠道黏液和血清中显著高于对照鱼，随后恢复正常水平。
text_zh: TSOD活性在特定时间点的肠道黏液和血清中显著高于对照鱼，随后恢复正常水平。
text_en: TSOD activity in intestinal mucus and serum was significantly higher than that of control fish at specific time points, then returned to normal levels.

quote: The LZM activity showed a significant increase in foregut mucus at 10 and 17 dpv, hindgut at 17 dpv mucus, and serum at 17 and 27 dpv, whereas no significant changes were observed in midgut mucus.
statement: 溶菌酶活性在前肠黏液、后肠黏液和血清中显著增加，但在中肠黏液中无显著变化。
text_zh: 溶菌酶活性在前肠黏液、后肠黏液和血清中显著增加，但在中肠黏液中无显著变化。
text_en: Lysozyme activity significantly increased in foregut mucus, hindgut mucus and serum, but showed no significant change in midgut mucus.
counterevidence: 中肠黏液中未观察到显著变化

quote: It is worth noting that the C3, TSOD, and LZM activities either in the gut mucus or serum of the booster-vaccinated fish were slightly higher than that in the vaccine group, suggesting the effect of this oral yeast vaccine administrated twice may be better than once.
statement: 加强免疫组的C3、TSOD和LZM活性略高于单次免疫组，提示两次给药的效果可能优于一次。
text_zh: 加强免疫组的C3、TSOD和LZM活性略高于单次免疫组，提示两次给药的效果可能优于一次。
text_en: The C3, TSOD and LZM activities in the booster immunization group were slightly higher than those in the single immunization group, suggesting that the effect of two doses may be better than one.

quote: These results indicated that the oral yeast vaccine could effectively improve the innate immune-related enzyme activities in body fluids.
statement: 结果表明口服酵母疫苗能有效提高体液中的先天免疫相关酶活性。
text_zh: 结果表明口服酵母疫苗能有效提高体液中的先天免疫相关酶活性。
text_en: The results showed that oral yeast vaccine could effectively increase the activity of innate immunity-related enzymes in body fluids.

quote: the viral loads in the Bo-va+Cha were significantly lower than that in the Con+Cha and Va+Cha groups, indicating the yeast vaccine could effectively inhibit the replication rate of the virus but require multiple vaccinations at least twice
statement: 酵母疫苗能显著降低病毒载量，有效抑制病毒复制率，但需要至少两次接种。
text_zh: 酵母疫苗能显著降低病毒载量，有效抑制病毒复制率，但需要至少两次接种。
text_en: Yeast vaccine can significantly reduce viral load and effectively inhibit the virus replication rate, but requires at least two doses.

quote: upon challenge with CyHV-2, the booster vaccine group had a significantly higher survival rate (76.7%) compared with the Va+Cha (40%) and Con+Cha (30%) groups
statement: 在CyHV-2攻击后，加强免疫组的存活率（76.7%）显著高于单次疫苗组（40%）和对照组（30%）。
text_zh: 在CyHV-2攻击后，加强免疫组的存活率（76.7%）显著高于单次疫苗组（40%）和对照组（30%）。
text_en: After CyHV-2 challenge, the survival rate of the booster vaccine group (76.7%) was significantly higher than that of the single vaccine group (40%) and the control group (30%).

quote: Although the RPS of the CyHV-2 in the vaccine group was only 14.3%, the booster vaccine effectively increased the RPS up to 66.7%
statement: 虽然单次疫苗组的相对存活保护率仅为14.3%，但加强免疫将相对存活保护率有效提高至66.7%。
text_zh: 虽然单次疫苗组的相对存活保护率仅为14.3%，但加强免疫将相对存活保护率有效提高至66.7%。
text_en: Although the relative percent survival of the single vaccine group was only 14.3%, booster vaccination effectively increased the relative percent survival to 66.7%.

quote: Vaccination is undoubtedly the most appropriate approach to control various fish diseases from an efficiency, safety, environmental and ethical standpoint.
statement: 疫苗接种被认为是从效率、安全性、环境和伦理角度控制各种鱼类疾病的最合适方法。
text_zh: 疫苗接种被认为是从效率、安全性、环境和伦理角度控制各种鱼类疾病的最合适方法。
text_en: Vaccination is considered the most appropriate method for controlling various fish diseases from the perspectives of efficiency, safety, environment, and ethics.
outcome: 疾病防控与伦理安全性

quote: Compared with the injection route, oral administration is considered to be the simplest and most cost-effective vaccination method, especially for small fish.
statement: 与注射途径相比，口服给药被认为是最简单且最具成本效益的疫苗接种方法，尤其适用于小型鱼类。
text_zh: 与注射途径相比，口服给药被认为是最简单且最具成本效益的疫苗接种方法，尤其适用于小型鱼类。
text_en: Compared to the injection route, oral administration is considered the simplest and most cost-effective method of vaccination, especially for small fish.
outcome: 操作简便性与应激减少

quote: Here, we prepared an oral yeast vaccine by surface-displaying CyHV-2 ORF25 and tested the vaccine for safety (i.e., mortality and intestinal morphological changes), immunogenicity (i.e., body fluid biochemistry indices and immune-related gene expression), and protection efficacy (i.e., intestinal pathological changes, viral load, relative survival).
statement: 本研究制备了一种通过表面展示CyHV-2 ORF25的口服酵母疫苗，并测试了其安全性（即死亡率和肠道形态变化）、免疫原性（即体液生化指标和免疫相关基因表达）以及保护效力（即肠道病理变化、病毒载量和相对存活率）。
text_zh: 本研究制备了一种通过表面展示CyHV-2 ORF25的口服酵母疫苗，并测试了其安全性（即死亡率和肠道形态变化）、免疫原性（即体液生化指标和免疫相关基因表达）以及保护效力（即肠道病理变化、病毒载量和相对存活率）。
text_en: This study prepared an oral yeast vaccine displaying CyHV-2 ORF25 on its surface, and tested its safety (i.e., mortality and intestinal morphological changes), immunogenicity (i.e., humoral biochemical indicators and immune-related gene expression), and protective efficacy (i.e., intestinal pathological changes, viral load, and relative survival rate).
outcome: 疫苗安全性与有效性评估

quote: Our findings indicated that the vaccine is safe and effective at protecting gibel carp against CyHV-2 infection.
statement: 研究结果表明该疫苗对预防鲫鱼感染CyHV-2是安全且有效的。
text_zh: 研究结果表明该疫苗对预防鲫鱼感染CyHV-2是安全且有效的。
text_en: The results indicate that this vaccine is safe and effective for preventing CyHV-2 infection in crucian carp.

quote: High ghrelin expression levels were detected after vaccination, suggesting that the oral yeast vaccine was highly palatable for gibel carp.
statement: 疫苗接种后检测到高水平的胃饥饿素表达，表明口服酵母疫苗对银鲫具有高度适口性。
text_zh: 疫苗接种后检测到高水平的胃饥饿素表达，表明口服酵母疫苗对银鲫具有高度适口性。
text_en: High levels of ghrelin expression were detected after vaccination, indicating that the oral yeast vaccine is highly palatable to silver crucian carp.

quote: Therefore, an enhanced immune response can be rapidly activated when live pathogens invade the body, thus protecting the host from pathogen infection.
statement: 因此，当活病原体侵入体内时，增强的免疫反应可以迅速激活，从而保护宿主免受病原体感染。
text_zh: 因此，当活病原体侵入体内时，增强的免疫反应可以迅速激活，从而保护宿主免受病原体感染。
text_en: Therefore, when live pathogens invade the body, the enhanced immune response can be rapidly activated, thereby protecting the host from pathogen infection.

quote: Our study found that the expression of igt and igm was significantly upregulated both in the gut and systemic tissues (i.e., spleen and head kidney) after vaccination.
statement: 本研究发现，接种疫苗后，肠道和全身组织（即脾脏和头肾）中igt和igm的表达均显著上调。
text_zh: 本研究发现，接种疫苗后，肠道和全身组织（即脾脏和头肾）中igt和igm的表达均显著上调。
text_en: This study found that after vaccination, the expression of igt and igm in the intestine and systemic tissues (i.e., spleen and head kidney) was significantly upregulated.

quote: Together, these data supported that the yeast vaccine could effectively induce innate and adaptive immune responses in both mucosal and systemic immunity of gibel carp.
statement: 这些数据共同支持酵母疫苗能有效诱导鲫鱼黏膜和全身系统的先天及适应性免疫反应。
text_zh: 这些数据共同支持酵母疫苗能有效诱导鲫鱼黏膜和全身系统的先天及适应性免疫反应。
text_en: These data collectively support that the yeast vaccine can effectively induce innate and adaptive immune responses in the mucosal and systemic systems of crucian carp.

quote: Complement, SOD, and lysozyme (LZM) in serum and mucus are important innate immune parameters and have often been used as indicators of disease resistance
statement: 血清和黏液中的补体、SOD和溶菌酶是重要的先天免疫参数，常被用作抗病力的指标。
text_zh: 血清和黏液中的补体、SOD和溶菌酶是重要的先天免疫参数，常被用作抗病力的指标。
text_en: Complement, SOD, and lysozyme in serum and mucus are important innate immune parameters and are often used as indicators of disease resistance.

quote: In the present study, the content of C3 increased significantly in the gut mucus and serum after vaccination.
statement: 在本研究中，接种后肠道黏液和血清中的C3含量显著增加。
text_zh: 在本研究中，接种后肠道黏液和血清中的C3含量显著增加。
text_en: In this study, C3 content in intestinal mucus and serum significantly increased after vaccination.

quote: A similar result has also been reported in the serum of gibel carp after immunization with DNA vaccine ORF25 with molecular adjuvant CCL35.2
statement: 在银鲫使用带有分子佐剂CCL35.2的DNA疫苗ORF25进行免疫后的血清中也报告了类似的结果。
text_zh: 在银鲫使用带有分子佐剂CCL35.2的DNA疫苗ORF25进行免疫后的血清中也报告了类似的结果。
text_en: Similar results were also reported in the serum of gibel carp after immunization with DNA vaccine ORF25 containing molecular adjuvant CCL35.2.
intervention: ORF25 DNA vaccine with CCL35.2 adjuvant

quote: This result is consistent with another study that reported increases in TSOD activity in response to an inactivated viral vaccine in gibel carp (38).
statement: 另一项研究报告，在鲫鱼中，灭活病毒疫苗导致TSOD活性增加。
text_zh: 另一项研究报告，在鲫鱼中，灭活病毒疫苗导致TSOD活性增加。
text_en: Another study reported that in crucian carp, the inactivated virus vaccine led to an increase in TSOD activity.

quote: In our study, igd expression was significantly elevated in the midgut and hindgut 10 days after vaccination, suggesting that IgD may have some antivirus function at the early stages of infection.
statement: 在本研究中，疫苗接种10天后，igd在中肠和后肠中的表达显著升高，表明IgD可能在感染早期具有一些抗病毒功能。
text_zh: 在本研究中，疫苗接种10天后，igd在中肠和后肠中的表达显著升高，表明IgD可能在感染早期具有一些抗病毒功能。
text_en: In this study, igd expression in the midgut and hindgut was significantly elevated 10 days after vaccination, indicating that IgD may have some antiviral function in the early stage of infection.

quote: Overall, our results showed that the oral yeast vaccine could effectively elicit innate and adaptive immune responses both in mucosal and systemic tissues, thereby protecting gibel carp against CyHV-2 infection.
statement: 总体而言，我们的结果表明，口服酵母疫苗能够有效诱导黏膜和全身组织的先天性和适应性免疫反应，从而保护银鲫免受CyHV-2感染。
text_zh: 总体而言，我们的结果表明，口服酵母疫苗能够有效诱导黏膜和全身组织的先天性和适应性免疫反应，从而保护银鲫免受CyHV-2感染。
text_en: Overall, our results indicate that oral yeast vaccine can effectively induce innate and adaptive immune responses in mucosal and systemic tissues, thereby protecting gibel carp from CyHV-2 infection.

quote: Overall, these results suggested that the oral yeast vaccine prepared herein can enhance immune responses, especially in the intestine, to establish a barrier against viral infection.
statement: 总体而言，这些结果表明本文制备的口服酵母疫苗可以增强免疫反应，特别是在肠道中，以建立针对病毒感染的屏障。
text_zh: 总体而言，这些结果表明本文制备的口服酵母疫苗可以增强免疫反应，特别是在肠道中，以建立针对病毒感染的屏障。
text_en: Overall, these results indicate that the oral yeast vaccine prepared in this study can enhance immune responses, particularly in the gut, to establish a barrier against viral infection.

quote: The yeast vaccine protects gibel carp from CyHV-2 infection
statement: 酵母疫苗保护银鲫免受CyHV-2感染。
text_zh: 酵母疫苗保护银鲫免受CyHV-2感染。
text_en: Yeast vaccine protects silver crucian carp from CyHV-2 infection.

quote: Typical clinical symptoms of HVHN were observed in the Con+Cha group at 2 dpc, such as eyeball protrusion, abdominal swelling and congestion, and body surface hemorrhages (Figure 6B).
statement: 在攻毒后2天，对照组观察到眼球突出、腹部肿胀充血和体表出血等典型的HVHN临床症状。
text_zh: 在攻毒后2天，对照组观察到眼球突出、腹部肿胀充血和体表出血等典型的HVHN临床症状。

quote: The histological analysis showed that CyHV-2 infection caused morphological changes in the gut (Figures 6C – E).
statement: 组织学分析显示CyHV-2感染导致肠道形态变化。
text_zh: 组织学分析显示CyHV-2感染导致肠道形态变化。
text_en: Histological analysis showed that CyHV-2 infection caused changes in intestinal morphology.

quote: The aspect ratio of intestinal folds in the Con+Cha group and the Va+Cha group was significantly decreased 4 days after infection with CyHV-2 compared to the controls, whereas there was no difference between the control group and booster vaccine group (Figures 6F – H).
statement: 与对照相比，Con+Cha组和Va+Cha组在CyHV-2感染4天后肠褶皱的长宽比显著降低，而对照组与加强免疫疫苗组之间无差异。
text_zh: 与对照相比，Con+Cha组和Va+Cha组在CyHV-2感染4天后肠褶皱的长宽比显著降低，而对照组与加强免疫疫苗组之间无差异。
text_en: Compared with the control group, the length-to-width ratio of intestinal folds in the Con+Cha and Va+Cha groups was significantly reduced 4 days after CyHV-2 infection, while there was no difference between the control group and the booster immunization vaccine group.

quote: Histological studies exhibited a significant increase in the number of goblet cells in the Va+Cha and Bo-va+Cha groups compared to Con+Cha fish after challenge (Supplementary Figure 1).
statement: 组织学研究表明，攻毒后Va+Cha和Bo-va+Cha组的杯状细胞数量较Con+Cha鱼显著增加。
text_zh: 组织学研究表明，攻毒后Va+Cha和Bo-va+Cha组的杯状细胞数量较Con+Cha鱼显著增加。
text_en: Histological studies showed that the number of goblet cells in the Va+Cha and Bo-va+Cha groups was significantly increased compared to Con+Cha fish after challenge.

quote: Moreover, different degrees of tissue damage were observed in both Con+Cha and Va+Cha groups, including epithelial cell sloughing and necrosis (Figures 6C – E).
statement: 此外，在Con+Cha和Va+Cha两组中均观察到不同程度的组织损伤，包括上皮细胞脱落和坏死。
text_zh: 此外，在Con+Cha和Va+Cha两组中均观察到不同程度的组织损伤，包括上皮细胞脱落和坏死。
text_en: In addition, varying degrees of tissue damage, including epithelial cell detachment and necrosis, were observed in both the Con+Cha and Va+Cha groups.
counterevidence: 单剂疫苗组仍出现组织损伤

quote: CyHV-2 is the main pathogen responsible for the development of herpesviral hematopoietic necrosis disease, which can lead to a high fatality rate and large economic loss within the farmed gibel carp (Carassius gibelio) industry
statement: CyHV-2是引起疱疹病毒造血坏死病的主要病原体，可导致养殖银鲫的高死亡率和大经济损失。
text_zh: CyHV-2是引起疱疹病毒造血坏死病的主要病原体，可导致养殖银鲫的高死亡率和大经济损失。
text_en: CyHV-2 is the main pathogen causing herpesvirus hematopoietic necrosis disease, which can lead to high mortality and large economic losses in farmed silver crucian carp.

quote: A previous study reported that LZM activity in the serum and intestinal mucus of grass carp increased significantly after immunization with an oral DNA vaccine compared to control fish (43).
statement: 先前的研究报告称，与对照鱼相比，草鱼口服DNA疫苗免疫后血清和肠道黏液中的溶菌酶活性显著增加。
text_zh: 先前的研究报告称，与对照鱼相比，草鱼口服DNA疫苗免疫后血清和肠道黏液中的溶菌酶活性显著增加。
text_en: Previous research reported that, compared to control fish, grass carp orally immunized with DNA vaccine showed significantly increased lysozyme activity in serum and intestinal mucus.

quote: A recent study on the effect of an oral microencapsulated vaccine in grass carp showed that compared to the unvaccinated fish, the fish vaccinated with the oral vaccine exhibited significant up-regulation in the activity of C3, TSOD, and LZM (44), which was very similar to our results.
statement: 最近一项关于草鱼口服微胶囊疫苗效果的研究表明，与未接种疫苗的鱼相比，口服疫苗组的C3、TSOD和LZM活性显著上调，这与本研究结果非常相似。
text_zh: 最近一项关于草鱼口服微胶囊疫苗效果的研究表明，与未接种疫苗的鱼相比，口服疫苗组的C3、TSOD和LZM活性显著上调，这与本研究结果非常相似。
text_en: A recent study on the effect of oral microencapsulated vaccines in grass carp showed that, compared to unvaccinated fish, C3, TSOD and LZM activities were significantly upregulated in the orally vaccinated group, which is very similar to the results of this study.
outcome: 免疫指标（C3, TSOD, LZM活性）

quote: The increase in the activity of these indicators may be due to an increase in the number of cells involved in this process, such as migration of head kidney leukocytes, or enhanced pathogen resistance (45).
statement: 这些指标活性的增加可能是由于参与该过程的细胞数量增加，例如头肾白细胞的迁移或病原体抵抗力的增强。
text_zh: 这些指标活性的增加可能是由于参与该过程的细胞数量增加，例如头肾白细胞的迁移或病原体抵抗力的增强。
text_en: The increase in the activity of these indicators may be due to an increase in the number of cells involved in this process, such as the migration of head kidney leukocytes or enhanced pathogen resistance.

quote: Although it is well known that yeast has immunostimulatory effects (17), previous studies have shown that feeding yeast alone did not induce significant differences in the antivirus gene expression and RPS compared to controls (24 , 30 , 70).
statement: 先前的研究表明，单独喂食酵母与对照组相比，在抗病毒基因表达和相对存活率（RPS）方面没有显著差异。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，单独喂食酵母与对照组相比，在抗病毒基因表达和相对存活率（RPS）方面没有显著差异。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that feeding yeast alone compared to the control group showed no significant difference in antiviral gene expression and relative percent survival (RPS).

quote: In conclusion, the orally-administered yeast vaccine developed in this study was deemed relatively safe and elicited strong innate and adaptive immune responses in both mucosal and systemic tissues.
statement: 本研究中开发的口服酵母疫苗被认为相对安全，并在黏膜和全身组织中引发了强烈的先天性和适应性免疫反应。
text_zh: 本研究中开发的口服酵母疫苗被认为相对安全，并在黏膜和全身组织中引发了强烈的先天性和适应性免疫反应。
text_en: The oral yeast vaccine developed in this study is considered relatively safe and induced strong innate and adaptive immune responses in mucosal and systemic tissues.

quote: More importantly, the vaccine remarkably improved the survival rate of gibel carp against CyHV-2 infection by relieving intestinal injury and inhibiting viral replication, which results in a significant increase in RPS rates.
statement: 该疫苗通过减轻肠道损伤和抑制病毒复制，显著提高了银鲫对CyHV-2感染的存活率，导致相对存活率（RPS）显著增加。
text_zh: 该疫苗通过减轻肠道损伤和抑制病毒复制，显著提高了银鲫对CyHV-2感染的存活率，导致相对存活率（RPS）显著增加。
text_en: The vaccine significantly improved the survival rate of gibel carp against CyHV-2 infection by reducing intestinal damage and inhibiting viral replication, resulting in a significant increase in relative percent survival (RPS).
outcome: 存活率、肠道损伤、病毒复制

quote: Whatever the case, the present results suggested that the oral yeast vaccine developed in this study is a promising candidate for controlling CyHV-2 in gibel carp farming.
statement: 无论如何，目前的结果表明，本研究中开发的口服酵母疫苗是控制养殖银鲫中CyHV-2的有希望的候选者。
text_zh: 无论如何，目前的结果表明，本研究中开发的口服酵母疫苗是控制养殖银鲫中CyHV-2的有希望的候选者。
text_en: In any case, the current results indicate that the oral yeast vaccine developed in this study is a promising candidate for controlling CyHV-2 in farmed silver crucian carp.

quote: Among the different administration methods, after oral vaccination, besides mortality, intestinal morphological changes and further damage on the intestine should be monitored to demonstrate safety.
statement: 在口服接种后，除了死亡率外，还应监测肠道形态变化及进一步的肠道损伤以证明安全性。
text_zh: 在口服接种后，除了死亡率外，还应监测肠道形态变化及进一步的肠道损伤以证明安全性。
text_en: After oral vaccination, in addition to mortality, intestinal morphological changes and further intestinal damage should be monitored to demonstrate safety.

quote: In our study, no fish died, and no significant tissue damage was observed in the gibel carp intestine after vaccination.
statement: 在本研究中，接种疫苗后没有鱼死亡，且鲫鱼肠道未观察到显著的组织损伤。
text_zh: 在本研究中，接种疫苗后没有鱼死亡，且鲫鱼肠道未观察到显著的组织损伤。
text_en: In this study, no fish died after vaccination, and no significant tissue damage was observed in the intestines of crucian carp.

quote: Collectively, these findings indicated that the recombinant yeast vaccine prepared herein was safe and therefore S. cerevisiae could serve as a novel carrier for CyHV-2 oral vaccines in gibel carp.
statement: 综合这些发现表明，本文制备的重组酵母疫苗是安全的，因此酿酒酵母可作为鲫鱼CyHV-2口服疫苗的新型载体。
text_zh: 综合这些发现表明，本文制备的重组酵母疫苗是安全的，因此酿酒酵母可作为鲫鱼CyHV-2口服疫苗的新型载体。
text_en: Taken together, these findings indicate that the recombinant yeast vaccine prepared in this study is safe, and therefore Saccharomyces cerevisiae can serve as a novel carrier for an oral CyHV-2 vaccine for crucian carp.

quote: The efficacy of a vaccine is largely determined by its ability to induce an immune response.
statement: 疫苗的功效主要取决于其诱导免疫反应的能力。
text_zh: 疫苗的功效主要取决于其诱导免疫反应的能力。
text_en: The efficacy of vaccines mainly depends on their ability to induce an immune response.

quote: After the challenge, a large number of control fish exhibited the typical clinical signs of HVNV, including dorsal fin bleeding, abdominal congestion, and eyeball protrusion (4).
statement: 攻毒后，大量对照鱼表现出典型的HVNV临床体征，包括背鳍出血、腹部充血和眼球突出。
text_zh: 攻毒后，大量对照鱼表现出典型的HVNV临床体征，包括背鳍出血、腹部充血和眼球突出。
text_en: After challenge, a large number of control fish showed typical clinical signs of HVNV, including dorsal fin hemorrhage, abdominal congestion, and exophthalmos.

quote: In a histological assay, we found that the most severe lesions including sloughing of epithelial cells and lower aspect ratio of intestinal folds were observed in the control fish after 2 dpc.
statement: 组织学检测发现，攻毒后2天，对照鱼观察到最严重的病变，包括上皮细胞脱落和肠褶皱长宽比降低。
text_zh: 组织学检测发现，攻毒后2天，对照鱼观察到最严重的病变，包括上皮细胞脱落和肠褶皱长宽比降低。
text_en: Histological examination found that, 2 days after challenge, the most severe lesions were observed in control fish, including epithelial cell detachment and a reduced length-to-width ratio of intestinal folds.

quote: A moderate pathological change was found in the fish that were vaccinated only once.
statement: 仅接种一次疫苗的鱼类发现了中等程度的病理变化。
text_zh: 仅接种一次疫苗的鱼类发现了中等程度的病理变化。
text_en: Moderate pathological changes were found in fish vaccinated only once.

quote: In contrast, no significant changes were observed in the gut mucus epithelial cells or the intestinal folds aspect ratio of the booster-vaccinated fish.
statement: 相比之下，加强免疫接种的鱼在肠道黏液上皮细胞或肠褶皱长宽比方面未观察到显著变化。
text_zh: 相比之下，加强免疫接种的鱼在肠道黏液上皮细胞或肠褶皱长宽比方面未观察到显著变化。
text_en: In contrast, no significant changes were observed in the intestinal mucus epithelial cells or intestinal fold length-to-width ratio in fish receiving booster immunization.

quote: Here, gibel carps significantly increased the number of intestinal goblet cells in both the vaccine and booster vaccine groups after being challenged with the CyHV-2, which may correlate with their survival and recovery.
statement: 在此研究中，CyHV-2攻毒后，疫苗组和加强疫苗组的银鲫肠道杯状细胞数量均显著增加，这可能与它们的存活和恢复有关。
text_zh: 在此研究中，CyHV-2攻毒后，疫苗组和加强疫苗组的银鲫肠道杯状细胞数量均显著增加，这可能与它们的存活和恢复有关。
text_en: In this study, after CyHV-2 challenge, the number of intestinal goblet cells in both the vaccinated group and the booster-vaccinated group increased significantly, which may be related to their survival and recovery.
outcome: 肠道屏障功能与存活率

quote: Moreover, the CyHV-2 viral load in the gut, spleen, and head kidney was significantly lower in the vaccinated fish, especially in the booster-vaccinated fish, than in the non-vaccinated fish.
statement: 接种疫苗的鱼（特别是加强免疫的鱼）肠道、脾脏和头肾中的CyHV-2病毒载量显著低于未接种的鱼。
text_zh: 接种疫苗的鱼（特别是加强免疫的鱼）肠道、脾脏和头肾中的CyHV-2病毒载量显著低于未接种的鱼。
text_en: The viral load of CyHV-2 in the gut, spleen and head kidney of vaccinated fish (especially those with booster immunization) was significantly lower than that of unvaccinated fish.

quote: The absence of pathological changes coincided with the improvement in the survival of vaccinated fish, especially those vaccinated twice, achieving a relative percent survival (RPS) rate of 14.3% in the vaccine group and 66.7% in the booster vaccine group.
statement: 无病理变化与疫苗接种鱼存活率的提高相一致，其中单次疫苗组相对存活率为14.3%，加强疫苗组为66.7%。
text_zh: 无病理变化与疫苗接种鱼存活率的提高相一致，其中单次疫苗组相对存活率为14.3%，加强疫苗组为66.7%。
text_en: The absence of pathological changes is consistent with improved survival rates in vaccinated fish, where the relative survival rate was 14.3% for the single vaccine group and 66.7% for the booster vaccine group.

quote: In turn, this suggested that the protective effect of booster vaccination is stronger than that of single vaccination.
statement: 这表明加强免疫的保护效果强于单次免疫。
text_zh: 这表明加强免疫的保护效果强于单次免疫。
text_en: This indicates that the protective effect of booster immunization is stronger than that of single immunization.
intervention_record: 加强免疫与单次免疫对比

quote: Previous studies have demonstrated that primary oral vaccination does not induce a strong immune response, whereas booster oral vaccination induces a strong secondary immune response and significantly improves the survival of fish (63 , 79).
statement: 先前的研究表明，初次口服疫苗不会诱导强烈的免疫反应，而加强口服疫苗会诱导强烈的二次免疫反应并显著提高鱼的存活率。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，初次口服疫苗不会诱导强烈的免疫反应，而加强口服疫苗会诱导强烈的二次免疫反应并显著提高鱼的存活率。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that the primary oral vaccine does not induce a strong immune response, whereas booster oral vaccination induces a strong secondary immune response and significantly improves fish survival rates.
outcome: 免疫反应强度与存活率

quote: It is worth noting that the presence of a strong adjuvant is required for oral vaccine preparations to improve disease resistance (63).
statement: 值得注意的是，口服疫苗制剂需要存在强佐剂才能提高抗病力。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，口服疫苗制剂需要存在强佐剂才能提高抗病力。
text_en: It is worth noting that oral vaccine formulations require the presence of strong adjuvants to enhance disease resistance.

quote: Fish were anesthetized before surgical removal of tissues.
statement: 鱼类在手术切除组织前进行了麻醉。
text_zh: 鱼类在手术切除组织前进行了麻醉。
text_en: Fish were anesthetized before surgical tissue removal.

quote: Gonadal tissues were harvested from FRCC, M4nRR, F3nRR and M3nRR after euthanasia.
statement: 在安乐死后从FRCC、M4nRR、F3nRR和M3nRR中采集了性腺组织。
text_zh: 在安乐死后从FRCC、M4nRR、F3nRR和M3nRR中采集了性腺组织。
text_en: Gonad tissues were collected from FRCC, M4nRR, F3nRR and M3nRR after euthanasia.

quote: All fish were maintained in open pools (0.067 ha) with suitable pH (7.0-8.5), water temperature (22–24℃), dissolved oxygen content (5.0–8.0 mg/L) and adequate forage.
statement: 所有鱼均饲养在露天池塘中，并维持了适宜的pH值、水温、溶解氧含量和充足的饵料。
text_zh: 所有鱼均饲养在露天池塘中，并维持了适宜的pH值、水温、溶解氧含量和充足的饵料。
text_en: All fish were raised in open-air ponds, with suitable pH, water temperature, dissolved oxygen content, and sufficient feed maintained.

quote: All dissections were performed under MS-222 anaesthesia (100 mg/L; Sigma-Aldrich).
statement: 所有解剖操作均在MS-222麻醉剂（100 mg/L）下进行。
text_zh: 所有解剖操作均在MS-222麻醉剂（100 mg/L）下进行。
text_en: All dissection procedures were performed under MS-222 anesthesia (100 mg/L).
outcome: 实验操作中的应激与疼痛控制

quote: The carp were put under complete anaesthesia with different concentrations of vanillin, maintained for 10 min and then gently removed and placed on a dissecting table to extract muscle parts for GC-IMS studies.
statement: 鲤鱼被置于不同浓度的香兰素中完全麻醉，维持10分钟后轻轻取出并放置在解剖台上提取肌肉部分用于GC-IMS研究。
text_zh: 鲤鱼被置于不同浓度的香兰素中完全麻醉，维持10分钟后轻轻取出并放置在解剖台上提取肌肉部分用于GC-IMS研究。
text_en: Common carp were completely anesthetized in different concentrations of vanillin, maintained for 10 minutes, gently removed and placed on a dissection table to extract muscle parts for GC-IMS study.

quote: Upon pathogen challenge, liver cells exhibit marked upregulation of immune-related genes (36 , 37).
statement: 在病原体攻击下，肝细胞表现出免疫相关基因的显著上调。
text_zh: 在病原体攻击下，肝细胞表现出免疫相关基因的显著上调。
text_en: Under pathogen attack, hepatocytes showed significant upregulation of immune-related genes.

quote: The carp were put under complete anaesthesia with different concentrations of vanillin, maintained for 10 min and then gently removed and placed on a dissecting table to remove the liver and gill parts for H&E staining.
statement: 鲤鱼被置于不同浓度的香兰素中完全麻醉，维持10分钟，然后轻轻取出并放在解剖台上以去除肝脏和鳃部分进行H&E染色。
text_zh: 鲤鱼被置于不同浓度的香兰素中完全麻醉，维持10分钟，然后轻轻取出并放在解剖台上以去除肝脏和鳃部分进行H&E染色。
text_en: Common carp were fully anesthetized in different concentrations of vanillin, maintained for 10 minutes, then gently removed and placed on a dissection table to remove the liver and gill parts for H&E staining.

quote: The carp were put under complete anaesthesia with different concentrations of vanillin, maintained for 10 min, and then gently removed and placed on a dissecting table to remove the muscle for the electronic nose test.
statement: 鲤鱼被置于不同浓度的香兰素中完全麻醉，维持10分钟，然后轻轻取出并放在解剖台上以去除肌肉用于电子鼻测试。
text_zh: 鲤鱼被置于不同浓度的香兰素中完全麻醉，维持10分钟，然后轻轻取出并放在解剖台上以去除肌肉用于电子鼻测试。
text_en: Common carp were completely anesthetized in different concentrations of vanillin, maintained for 10 minutes, then gently removed and placed on a dissection table to remove muscle for electronic nose testing.

quote: Microstructural measurements showed a slight swelling of the chlorine-secreting cells at all treatment concentrations, which was not significantly different from the control, except at 1.00 g/L, at which the width and spacing of the gill lamellae increased significantly.
statement: 微观结构测量显示所有处理浓度下氯分泌细胞轻微肿胀（除1.00 g/L外无显著差异），且在1.00 g/L时鳃小片的宽度和间距显著增加。
text_zh: 微观结构测量显示所有处理浓度下氯分泌细胞轻微肿胀（除1.00 g/L外无显著差异），且在1.00 g/L时鳃小片的宽度和间距显著增加。
text_en: Microstructural measurements showed slight swelling of chloride cells at all treatment concentrations (no significant difference except at 1.00 g/L), and a significant increase in the width and spacing of lamellae at 1.00 g/L.

quote: The effective concentration for this determination was defined as the onset of anaesthesia within 3 min and awakening within 5 min
statement: 有效浓度的定义标准为在3分钟内进入麻醉状态并在5分钟内苏醒。
text_zh: 有效浓度的定义标准为在3分钟内进入麻醉状态并在5分钟内苏醒。
text_en: The definition criterion for effective concentration is entering the anesthetic state within 3 minutes and recovering within 5 minutes.

quote: Six treatment concentrations (0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00, 1.25, and 1.50 g/L) were used and 60 carp were randomly selected in total for the treatment and control groups.
statement: 实验使用了六个处理浓度（0.25至1.50 g/L），并随机选取了共60条鱼用于处理组和对照组。
text_zh: 实验使用了六个处理浓度（0.25至1.50 g/L），并随机选取了共60条鱼用于处理组和对照组。
text_en: The experiment used six treatment concentrations (0.25 to 1.50 g/L), and a total of 60 fish were randomly selected for the treatment and control groups.

quote: When the fish entered the anaesthesia phase (A 3), the corresponding time was recorded as anaesthesia onset, then the fish were immediately transferred to fresh water for recovery and the time was recorded as the onset of recovery phase 3 (R 3).
statement: 当鱼进入麻醉阶段(A3)时记录为麻醉起始，随后立即转移至清水中恢复，并记录恢复阶段3(R3)的起始时间。
text_zh: 当鱼进入麻醉阶段(A3)时记录为麻醉起始，随后立即转移至清水中恢复，并记录恢复阶段3(R3)的起始时间。
text_en: Anesthesia onset was recorded when the fish entered anesthesia stage (A3), followed immediately by transfer to clean water for recovery, and the start time of recovery stage 3 (R3) was recorded.

quote: When the anaesthetic concentration is low, the fish cannot enter anaesthesia quickly; when the anaesthetic concentration is high, the fish enter anaesthesia too quickly and the behavioural characteristics of the anaesthesia are difficult to distinguish.
statement: 麻醉浓度过低时鱼无法快速进入麻醉状态；浓度过高时鱼进入麻醉过快且麻醉行为特征难以区分。
text_zh: 麻醉浓度过低时鱼无法快速进入麻醉状态；浓度过高时鱼进入麻醉过快且麻醉行为特征难以区分。
text_en: When the anesthetic concentration is too low, fish cannot enter the anesthetized state quickly; when the concentration is too high, fish enter anesthesia too fast and the behavioral characteristics of anesthesia are difficult to distinguish.

quote: As the concentration of vanillin increased, the time taken to achieve deep anaesthesia (stage A5; anaesthesia time) decreased and the time for complete recovery increased
statement: 随着香兰素浓度增加，达到深度麻醉所需的时间减少，而完全恢复所需的时间增加。
text_zh: 随着香兰素浓度增加，达到深度麻醉所需的时间减少，而完全恢复所需的时间增加。
text_en: As the vanillin concentration increases, the time required to reach deep anesthesia decreases, while the time required for full recovery increases.

quote: the anaesthesia time with 0.25 g/L vanillin was markedly longer than at other concentrations.
statement: 使用0.25 g/L香兰素的麻醉时间明显长于其他浓度。
text_zh: 使用0.25 g/L香兰素的麻醉时间明显长于其他浓度。
text_en: The anesthesia time using 0.25 g/L vanillin was significantly longer than that of other concentrations.

quote: The average anaesthesia time at 1.50 g/L was 50% of that at 0.50 g/L, whereas the average recovery time was 281% of that at 0.50 g/L.
statement: 1.50 g/L时的平均麻醉时间是0.50 g/L时的50%，而平均恢复时间是0.50 g/L时的281%。
text_zh: 1.50 g/L时的平均麻醉时间是0.50 g/L时的50%，而平均恢复时间是0.50 g/L时的281%。
text_en: At 1.50 g/L, the average anesthesia time was 50% of that at 0.50 g/L, while the average recovery time was 281% of that at 0.50 g/L.

quote: The recovery rate of carp was 100% at all six vanillin concentrations, indicating that, within the concentration range of 0.50–1.50 g/L, the vanillin bath was safe for the fish.
statement: 在所有六个香兰素浓度下，鲤鱼的恢复率均为100%，表明在0.50–1.50 g/L的浓度范围内，香兰素药浴对鱼类是安全的。
text_zh: 在所有六个香兰素浓度下，鲤鱼的恢复率均为100%，表明在0.50–1.50 g/L的浓度范围内，香兰素药浴对鱼类是安全的。
text_en: At all six vanillin concentrations, the recovery rate of common carp was 100%, indicating that vanillin bath anesthesia is safe for fish within the concentration range of 0.50–1.50 g/L.

quote: As the vanillin concentration increased, the anaesthesia time decreased, in a dose-responsive, though nonlinear manner
statement: 随着香兰素浓度的增加，麻醉时间以剂量依赖性但非线性的方式减少。
text_zh: 随着香兰素浓度的增加，麻醉时间以剂量依赖性但非线性的方式减少。
text_en: As the concentration of vanillin increased, the anesthesia time decreased in a dose-dependent but non-linear manner.

quote: In this study, the anaesthetic effect of vanillin was tested on crucian carp and the resulting changes in physiological and biochemical parameters, pathology and volatile aroma compounds were investigated.
statement: 本研究测试了香兰素对鲫鱼的麻醉效果，并调查了由此引起的生理生化参数、病理学和挥发性香气化合物的变化。
text_zh: 本研究测试了香兰素对鲫鱼的麻醉效果，并调查了由此引起的生理生化参数、病理学和挥发性香气化合物的变化。
text_en: This study tested the anesthetic effect of vanillin on crucian carp and investigated the resulting changes in physiological and biochemical parameters, pathology, and volatile aroma compounds.
outcome: 麻醉效果及生理病理指标

quote: The fish were maintained in a temperature-controlled circulating water filtration system (dissolved oxygen ≥ 7 mg/L, pH 7–8), at the National Agricultural Products Modern Logistics Engineering Technology Research Center.
statement: 鱼在温度控制的循环水过滤系统中饲养（溶解氧≥7 mg/L，pH 7–8）。
text_zh: 鱼在温度控制的循环水过滤系统中饲养（溶解氧≥7 mg/L，pH 7–8）。
text_en: Fish were reared in a temperature-controlled recirculating water filtration system (dissolved oxygen ≥7 mg/L, pH 7–8).

quote: Vanillin had aanaestheticic effect on crucian carp and these findings provide a theoretical basis for improving the transport and experimental manipulation of crucian carp.
statement: 香兰素对鲫鱼具有麻醉作用，为改善鲫鱼的运输和实验操作提供了理论基础。
text_zh: 香兰素对鲫鱼具有麻醉作用，为改善鲫鱼的运输和实验操作提供了理论基础。
text_en: Vanillin has an anesthetic effect on crucian carp, providing a theoretical basis for improving the transport and experimental operations of crucian carp.
outcome: 运输与实验操作中的应激管理

quote: During the production and transportation of fish, trauma and stress often occur, affecting their quality and survival rate.
statement: 在鱼类的生产和运输过程中，经常发生创伤和应激，影响其质量和存活率。
text_zh: 在鱼类的生产和运输过程中，经常发生创伤和应激，影响其质量和存活率。
text_en: Trauma and stress frequently occur during the production and transport of fish, affecting their quality and survival rate.
outcome: 生产与运输过程中的创伤和应激

quote: Fish anaesthetics are widely used, as they have a sedative effect during transport, and effectively reduce fish mortality.
statement: 鱼类麻醉剂被广泛使用，因为它们在运输过程中具有镇静作用，并能有效降低鱼类死亡率。
text_zh: 鱼类麻醉剂被广泛使用，因为它们在运输过程中具有镇静作用，并能有效降低鱼类死亡率。
text_en: Fish anaesthetics are widely used because they have a sedative effect during transport and effectively reduce fish mortality.

quote: MS-222 solution is weakly acidic, resulting in the plasma-cortisol content increasing after the fish recover from deep anaesthesia; exposure to direct sunlight may produce toxicity to fish when using MS-222 [ 1 ].
statement: MS-222溶液呈弱酸性，导致鱼类从深度麻醉恢复后血浆皮质醇含量增加；使用MS-222时暴露于阳光直射可能对鱼类产生毒性。
text_zh: MS-222溶液呈弱酸性，导致鱼类从深度麻醉恢复后血浆皮质醇含量增加；使用MS-222时暴露于阳光直射可能对鱼类产生毒性。
text_en: MS-222 solution is weakly acidic, leading to increased plasma cortisol levels in fish after recovery from deep anesthesia; exposure to direct sunlight when using MS-222 may be toxic to fish.
outcome: 生理应激指标（皮质醇）及毒性风险
counterevidence: MS-222导致皮质醇升高及潜在毒性

quote: Eugenol is volatile and its effect diminishes during anaesthesia [ 2 , 3 ];
statement: 丁香酚易挥发，且在麻醉过程中其效果会减弱。
text_zh: 丁香酚易挥发，且在麻醉过程中其效果会减弱。
text_en: Eugenol is volatile, and its effect weakens during the anesthesia process.

quote: 2-Phenoxyethanol is hazardous to fishery workers, causing neurological syndromes after prolonged exposure, has a severe, long-lasting residual effect, and remains active for three days after the fish recover [ 4 ].
statement: 2-苯氧乙醇对渔业工人有害，长期接触会导致神经系统综合征，具有严重且持久的残留效应，并在鱼类恢复后仍保持活性三天。
text_zh: 2-苯氧乙醇对渔业工人有害，长期接触会导致神经系统综合征，具有严重且持久的残留效应，并在鱼类恢复后仍保持活性三天。
text_en: 2-Phenoxyethanol is harmful to fishery workers; long-term exposure leads to neurological syndromes, has severe and persistent residual effects, and remains active for three days even after fish recovery.
outcome: 操作人员健康风险及动物体内残留
counterevidence: 对工人有害，残留效应长

quote: Plant extracts, such as alfalfa essential oil [ 7 ], thyme essential oil [ 8 ], and menthol [ 9 ] all have anaesthetic effects on fish.
statement: 植物提取物，如苜蓿精油、百里香精油和薄荷醇，均对鱼类具有麻醉作用。
text_zh: 植物提取物，如苜蓿精油、百里香精油和薄荷醇，均对鱼类具有麻醉作用。
text_en: Plant extracts, such as alfalfa essential oil, thyme essential oil and menthol, all have anesthetic effects on fish.

quote: Liang et al. [ 31 ] analysed the anaesthetic effect of clove oil on the blood indexes of tilapia; the content of WBC, RBC, HGB, and PLT increased after anaesthesia.
statement: 丁香油麻醉罗非鱼后，白细胞、红细胞、血红蛋白和血小板含量增加。
text_zh: 丁香油麻醉罗非鱼后，白细胞、红细胞、血红蛋白和血小板含量增加。
text_en: After eugenol anesthesia of tilapia, the contents of white blood cells, red blood cells, hemoglobin, and platelets increased.

quote: In this study, vanillin-induced anaesthesia moderately reduced the contents of WBC and HGB, though more than halved the contents of RBC and PLT.
statement: 香兰素诱导的麻醉中度降低了白细胞和血红蛋白含量，但使红细胞和血小板含量减少了一半以上。
text_zh: 香兰素诱导的麻醉中度降低了白细胞和血红蛋白含量，但使红细胞和血小板含量减少了一半以上。
text_en: Vanillin-induced anesthesia moderately reduced white blood cell and hemoglobin content, but decreased red blood cell and platelet content by more than half.

quote: In this study, the ALT activity of carp anaesthetized with vanillin was reduced, whereas the AST activity markedly increased, indicating that there may have been some liver damage in the fish
statement: 香兰素麻醉鲤鱼后，ALT活性降低而AST活性显著升高，表明鱼类可能存在肝脏损伤。
text_zh: 香兰素麻醉鲤鱼后，ALT活性降低而AST活性显著升高，表明鱼类可能存在肝脏损伤。
text_en: After vanillin anesthesia of carp, ALT activity decreased while AST activity significantly increased, indicating that fish may have liver damage.

quote: Vanillin had an anaesthetic effect on crucian carp when added to the water in which the fish were present.
statement: 香兰素加入水中对鲫鱼具有麻醉作用。
text_zh: 香兰素加入水中对鲫鱼具有麻醉作用。
text_en: Adding vanillin to water has an anesthetic effect on crucian carp.

quote: With an increasing vanillin concentration, the time taken to achieve deep anaesthesia decreased in an exponential, dose-responsive manner and the recovery time of the fish, when removed to vanillin-free water, increased.
statement: 随着香兰素浓度增加，达到深度麻醉所需的时间呈指数级剂量依赖性减少，而鱼在移入无香兰素水后的恢复时间增加。
text_zh: 随着香兰素浓度增加，达到深度麻醉所需的时间呈指数级剂量依赖性减少，而鱼在移入无香兰素水后的恢复时间增加。
text_en: As vanillin concentration increases, the time required to reach deep anesthesia decreases in an exponential dose-dependent manner, while the recovery time of fish after transfer to vanillin-free water increases.

quote: All the test fish recovered completely and there was no evidence of adverse effects.
statement: 所有测试鱼均完全恢复，且没有证据表明存在不良反应。
text_zh: 所有测试鱼均完全恢复，且没有证据表明存在不良反应。
text_en: All test fish fully recovered, and there was no evidence of adverse reactions.

quote: Liver tissue sections (Figure 6) showed that the hepatocytes in the control and treatment groups were evenly arranged, intact and clear, except at 1 g/L vanillin, and vacuolation in the treatment groups was more marked than in the control.
statement: 在1 g/L香兰素处理组中，肝细胞出现空泡化，且比对照组更明显。
text_zh: 在1 g/L香兰素处理组中，肝细胞出现空泡化，且比对照组更明显。
text_en: In the group treated with 1 g/L vanillin, hepatocytes showed vacuolization, which was more pronounced than in the control group.

quote: At 1.50 g/L vanillin, the accumulation of hepatocyte nuclei was greater than in the control, though their integrity was better.
statement: 在1.50 g/L香兰素浓度下，肝细胞核的积累多于对照组，但其完整性更好。
text_zh: 在1.50 g/L香兰素浓度下，肝细胞核的积累多于对照组，但其完整性更好。
text_en: At a vanillin concentration of 1.50 g/L, accumulation in hepatocyte nuclei was greater than in the control group, but their integrity was better.

quote: Compared to the control, the filaments and lamellae were swollen at 1.50 g/L vanillin; there was a proliferation of flattened and columnar cells in the vascular walls of the filaments, an increase in chlorine-secreting cells, curling and fusion of the lamellae, and detachment of the supragillar cells.
statement: 与对照组相比，1.50 g/L香兰素处理组的鳃丝和鳃小片肿胀，血管壁细胞增殖，氯分泌细胞增加，鳃小片卷曲融合及上层细胞脱落。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，1.50 g/L香兰素处理组的鳃丝和鳃小片肿胀，血管壁细胞增殖，氯分泌细胞增加，鳃小片卷曲融合及上层细胞脱落。
text_en: Compared with the control group, the gill filaments and lamellae in the 1.50 g/L vanillin treatment group showed swelling, proliferation of vascular wall cells, an increase in chloride-secreting cells, curling and fusion of the lamellae, and shedding of the upper layer cells.

quote: An increased concentration of vanillin shortened the time taken to achieve deep anaesthesia but increased the recovery time.
statement: 香兰素浓度增加会缩短达到深度麻醉所需的时间，但会延长恢复时间。
text_zh: 香兰素浓度增加会缩短达到深度麻醉所需的时间，但会延长恢复时间。
text_en: Increasing vanillin concentration shortens the time required to reach deep anesthesia but prolongs recovery time.

quote: The levels of white blood cells, red blood cells, haemoglobinn, platelets, alanine aminotransferase, alkaline phosphatase, lactate dehydrogenase, phosphorus, potassium, magnesium, total protein, and serum albumin were lower than the control in the vanillin treatment group.
statement: 在香兰素处理组中，白细胞、红细胞、血红蛋白、血小板、丙氨酸氨基转移酶、碱性磷酸酶、乳酸脱氢酶、磷、钾、镁、总蛋白和血清白蛋白的水平低于对照组。
text_zh: 在香兰素处理组中，白细胞、红细胞、血红蛋白、血小板、丙氨酸氨基转移酶、碱性磷酸酶、乳酸脱氢酶、磷、钾、镁、总蛋白和血清白蛋白的水平低于对照组。
text_en: In the vanillin treatment group, levels of white blood cells, red blood cells, hemoglobin, platelets, alanine aminotransferase, alkaline phosphatase, lactate dehydrogenase, phosphorus, potassium, magnesium, total protein, and serum albumin were lower than in the control group.
counterevidence: 多项生理生化指标显著降低

quote: Histology showed no effect of vanillin on the liver, except at 1.00 g/L vanillin.
statement: 组织学显示，除1.00 g/L香兰素外，香兰素对肝脏无影响。
text_zh: 组织学显示，除1.00 g/L香兰素外，香兰素对肝脏无影响。
text_en: Histology showed that vanillin had no effect on the liver, except at 1.00 g/L.
counterevidence: 高浓度(1.00 g/L)下出现肝脏影响

quote: Vanillin resulted in a nondose-responsive effect on the gill tissue, increasing the width and spacing of the gill lamellae.
statement: 香兰素对鳃组织产生了非剂量依赖性效应，增加了鳃丝的宽度和间距。
text_zh: 香兰素对鳃组织产生了非剂量依赖性效应，增加了鳃丝的宽度和间距。
text_en: Vanillin produced a non-dose-dependent effect on the gill tissue, increasing the width and spacing of the gill filaments.

quote: the vanillin treatment ALT concentration initially markedly decreased, then slightly, though not significantly, increased, with increased vanillin concentration, except for a marked increase at 1.50 g/L vanillin, to 111.77 ± 21.97 U/L (Figure 3 A).
statement: 随着香兰素浓度增加，血清ALT浓度先显著下降后轻微上升，但在1.50 g/L时显著升高至111.77 ± 21.97 U/L。
text_zh: 随着香兰素浓度增加，血清ALT浓度先显著下降后轻微上升，但在1.50 g/L时显著升高至111.77 ± 21.97 U/L。
text_en: As the vanillin concentration increased, serum ALT concentration first decreased significantly and then slightly increased, but at 1.50 g/L it significantly rose to 111.77 ± 21.97 U/L.

quote: the vanillin treatment AST concentration markedly increased, though remained relatively constant, at all vanillin treatment concentrations (Figure 3 B).
statement: 在所有香兰素处理浓度下，血清AST浓度均显著增加，但保持相对恒定。
text_zh: 在所有香兰素处理浓度下，血清AST浓度均显著增加，但保持相对恒定。
text_en: At all vanillin treatment concentrations, serum AST concentration increased significantly but remained relatively constant.

quote: the vanillin treatment ALT concentration initially markedly decreased, then gradually increased, with the increased vanillin concentration (Figure 3 C).
statement: 随着香兰素浓度增加，血清ALP浓度先显著下降后逐渐上升。（注：原文此处误写为ALT，结合上下文及图3C标题应为ALP）
text_zh: 随着香兰素浓度增加，血清ALP浓度先显著下降后逐渐上升。（注：原文此处误写为ALT，结合上下文及图3C标题应为ALP）
text_en: As the vanillin concentration increased, serum ALP concentration first decreased significantly and then gradually increased. (Note: The original text mistakenly wrote ALT here; based on the context and the title of Figure 3C, it should be ALP.)

quote: The control serum LDH concentration was 2560.02 ± 7.23 U/L and moderately decreased at all vanillin treatment concentrations, with a minimum of 1.00 g/L (Figure 3 D).
statement: 在所有香兰素处理浓度下，血清LDH浓度均中度降低，在1.00 g/L时达到最低值。
text_zh: 在所有香兰素处理浓度下，血清LDH浓度均中度降低，在1.00 g/L时达到最低值。
text_en: At all vanillin treatment concentrations, serum LDH concentration was moderately decreased, reaching the lowest value at 1.00 g/L.

quote: To observe stable and distinct anaesthetic staging characteristics, an appropriate anaesthetic concentration is required.
statement: 观察稳定且明显的麻醉分期特征需要适当的麻醉浓度。
text_zh: 观察稳定且明显的麻醉分期特征需要适当的麻醉浓度。
text_en: Observing stable and obvious anesthetic stage characteristics requires appropriate anesthetic concentration.

quote: Based on the results from Section 2.2.1 , the behavioural characteristics of the carp during anaesthesia were observed in a 1.00 g/L vanillin solution.
statement: 基于2.2.1节的结果，在1.00 g/L香兰素溶液中观察了鲤鱼在麻醉期间的行为特征。
text_zh: 基于2.2.1节的结果，在1.00 g/L香兰素溶液中观察了鲤鱼在麻醉期间的行为特征。
text_en: Based on the results in Section 2.2.1, behavioral characteristics of common carp during anesthesia were observed in a 1.00 g/L vanillin solution.

quote: The anaesthesia (A 0 –A 4) and recovery (R 1 –R 4) periods were classified according to the criteria of Mirghaed et al. [ 21 ] and correlated with the behavioural characteristics of the different periods.
statement: 根据Mirghaed等人的标准对麻醉（A0–A4）和恢复（R1–R4）阶段进行了分类，并与不同阶段的行为特征相关联。
text_zh: 根据Mirghaed等人的标准对麻醉（A0–A4）和恢复（R1–R4）阶段进行了分类，并与不同阶段的行为特征相关联。
text_en: Anesthesia (A0–A4) and recovery (R1–R4) stages were classified according to the criteria of Mirghaed et al. and associated with behavioral characteristics at different stages.

quote: Three crucian carp were randomly placed in treatment (different vanillin concentrations) and control tanks, then each fish was tested for anaesthesia (each fish was tested only once).
statement: 三条鲫鱼被随机放入处理组（不同香兰素浓度）和对照组水箱中，然后对每条鱼进行麻醉测试（每条鱼仅测试一次）。
text_zh: 三条鲫鱼被随机放入处理组（不同香兰素浓度）和对照组水箱中，然后对每条鱼进行麻醉测试（每条鱼仅测试一次）。
text_en: Three crucian carp were randomly placed into treatment tanks (with different vanillin concentrations) and control tanks, and then each fish was subjected to an anesthesia test (each fish was tested only once).
limitations: each fish was tested only once

quote: The fish were kept in a state of complete anaesthesia for 10 min, and then blood samples (5 mL) were drawn with a syringe from the tail vein.
statement: 鱼保持完全麻醉状态10分钟，然后用注射器从尾静脉抽取血样（5毫升）。
text_zh: 鱼保持完全麻醉状态10分钟，然后用注射器从尾静脉抽取血样（5毫升）。
text_en: Fish were kept in a state of complete anesthesia for 10 minutes, after which blood samples (5 ml) were drawn from the caudal vein using a syringe.

quote: Part of the sample was mixed with an anticoagulant and used for the determination of the physiological parameters, red blood cells (RBC), white blood cells (WBC), haemoglobin (HGB), and platelets (PLT);
statement: 部分样本与抗凝剂混合，用于测定红细胞、白细胞、血红蛋白和血小板等生理参数；
text_zh: 部分样本与抗凝剂混合，用于测定红细胞、白细胞、血红蛋白和血小板等生理参数；
text_en: Some samples were mixed with anticoagulants for the determination of physiological parameters such as red blood cells, white blood cells, hemoglobin, and platelets;

quote: The probiotic potentials of the strain for aquaculture are investigated by using crucian carp as a model aquatic host and A. salmonicida as an aquatic bacterial pathogenic strain.
statement: 该研究使用鲫鱼作为模型宿主和杀鲑气单胞菌作为病原菌来探究该菌株在水产养殖中的益生菌潜力。
text_zh: 该研究使用鲫鱼作为模型宿主和杀鲑气单胞菌作为病原菌来探究该菌株在水产养殖中的益生菌潜力。
text_en: This study used crucian carp as the model host and Aeromonas salmonicida as the pathogen to investigate the probiotic potential of this strain in aquaculture.

quote: The LDH activity was moderately reduced, suggesting that anaesthesia reduced myocardium damage
statement: LDH活性适度降低，表明麻醉减少了心肌损伤。
text_zh: LDH活性适度降低，表明麻醉减少了心肌损伤。
text_en: LDH activity moderately decreased, indicating that anesthesia reduced myocardial injury.

quote: The ALP activity of crucian carp anaesthetized by the various concentrations of vanillin solution was lower than that of the control group, indicating that the vanillin aqueous solution contained components that inhibited ALP activity
statement: 不同浓度香兰素溶液麻醉的鲫鱼ALP活性低于对照组，表明香兰素水溶液含有抑制ALP活性的成分。
text_zh: 不同浓度香兰素溶液麻醉的鲫鱼ALP活性低于对照组，表明香兰素水溶液含有抑制ALP活性的成分。
text_en: The ALP activity of crucian carp anesthetized with vanillin solutions at different concentrations was lower than that of the control group, indicating that the aqueous vanillin solution contains components that inhibit ALP activity.

quote: In this study, the levels of PO 4 3− and Mg 2+ in anaesthetized crucian carp were reduced, indicating that vanillin did not cause kidney damage.
statement: 本研究中麻醉鲫鱼的PO43-和Mg2+水平降低，表明香兰素未造成肾脏损伤。
text_zh: 本研究中麻醉鲫鱼的PO43-和Mg2+水平降低，表明香兰素未造成肾脏损伤。
text_en: In this study, the PO43- and Mg2+ levels in anesthetized crucian carp decreased, indicating that vanillin did not cause kidney damage.

quote: In this study, with the increase in the vanillin mass concentration, the Na + content of each concentration of the anaesthesia group increased compared with the control group, and the K + content decreased compared with the control group, and it was speculated that the higher concentrations of vanillin caused increased gill tissue cell deformation.
statement: 随着香兰素质量浓度增加，麻醉组Na+含量较对照组升高，K+含量较对照组降低，推测高浓度香兰素导致鳃组织细胞变形增加。
text_zh: 随着香兰素质量浓度增加，麻醉组Na+含量较对照组升高，K+含量较对照组降低，推测高浓度香兰素导致鳃组织细胞变形增加。
text_en: As the mass concentration of vanillin increased, Na+ content in the anesthesia group was higher than that in the control group, and K+ content was lower than that in the control group; it is speculated that high concentrations of vanillin caused increased deformation of gill tissue cells.
outcome: 鳃部完整性/渗透压调节

quote: The resistance of crucian carp of both FiA2 and CK groups to the infectious A. salmonicida after a feeding trials of 30 days was evaluated in terms of percentage survival rate.
statement: FiA2组和对照组（CK）鲫鱼对感染性鳗弧菌（A. salmonicida）的抵抗力通过存活率百分比进行评估，经过30天的喂养试验。
text_zh: FiA2组和对照组（CK）鲫鱼对感染性鳗弧菌（A. salmonicida）的抵抗力通过存活率百分比进行评估，经过30天的喂养试验。
text_en: The resistance of crucian carp in the FiA2 group and the control group (CK) to infection with Aeromonas salmonicida was assessed by survival rate percentage after a 30-day feeding trial.

quote: This is consistent with the anaesthesia of tilapia with MS-222, which decreased serum K + in a dose-responsive manner, whereas the Na + concentration remained relatively stable [ 40 ].
statement: 这与MS-222麻醉罗非鱼的结果一致，即血清K+呈剂量依赖性降低，而Na+浓度保持相对稳定。
text_zh: 这与MS-222麻醉罗非鱼的结果一致，即血清K+呈剂量依赖性降低，而Na+浓度保持相对稳定。
text_en: This is consistent with the results of MS-222 anesthesia in tilapia, where serum K+ decreased in a dose-dependent manner while Na+ concentrations remained relatively stable.

quote: In this study, the treatment group’s blood glucose levels were higher than the control in different proportions, possibly due to less dissolved oxygen in the water, which lowered the metabolic rate and/or because of the reduced physical activity of the anaesthetized fish.
statement: 本研究中，处理组的血糖水平以不同比例高于对照组，可能是由于水中溶解氧较少降低了代谢率和/或麻醉鱼类的体力活动减少所致。
text_zh: 本研究中，处理组的血糖水平以不同比例高于对照组，可能是由于水中溶解氧较少降低了代谢率和/或麻醉鱼类的体力活动减少所致。
text_en: In this study, the blood glucose levels of the treatment group were higher than those of the control group by different proportions, possibly due to reduced metabolic rate caused by lower dissolved oxygen in the water and/or reduced physical activity of the anesthetized fish.

quote: The increases in GLU concentration after anaesthesia may result from a need for increased energy associated with the stress response, which is met by increased glycogenolysis.
statement: 麻醉后GLU浓度的增加可能是由应激反应相关的能量需求增加引起的，通过糖原分解增加来满足这一需求。
text_zh: 麻醉后GLU浓度的增加可能是由应激反应相关的能量需求增加引起的，通过糖原分解增加来满足这一需求。
text_en: The increase in GLU concentration after anesthesia may be caused by increased energy demand associated with the stress response, which is met through increased glycogenolysis.

quote: At higher vanillin concentrations, there was an irregular decrease in blood glucose, consistent with more rapid anaesthesia, which is consistent with a previous report on electroanesthetized pearl gentian grouper [ 43 ].
statement: 在较高浓度的香兰素下，血糖出现不规则下降，这与更快的麻醉效果一致，也与之前关于电麻醉珍珠龙胆石斑鱼的报道一致。
text_zh: 在较高浓度的香兰素下，血糖出现不规则下降，这与更快的麻醉效果一致，也与之前关于电麻醉珍珠龙胆石斑鱼的报道一致。
text_en: At higher concentrations of vanillin, blood glucose showed irregular decreases, which is consistent with faster anesthetic effects and with previous reports on electric anesthesia in pearl gentian grouper.

quote: In contrast, blood glucose concentrations decreased after CO 2 anaesthesia of the grouper [ 44 ].
statement: 相比之下，石斑鱼经CO2麻醉后血糖浓度降低。
text_zh: 相比之下，石斑鱼经CO2麻醉后血糖浓度降低。
text_en: In contrast, blood glucose concentration decreased in grouper after CO2 anesthesia.

quote: In this study, except for triglycerides, the TP and ALB contents of the crucian carp after anaesthesia were lower than those in the control group, indicating that the protein breakdown and liver glycogen decomposition of crucian carp decreased after anaesthesia.
statement: 本研究中，除甘油三酯外，麻醉后鲫鱼的总蛋白和白蛋白含量低于对照组，表明麻醉后鲫鱼的蛋白质分解和肝糖原分解减少。
text_zh: 本研究中，除甘油三酯外，麻醉后鲫鱼的总蛋白和白蛋白含量低于对照组，表明麻醉后鲫鱼的蛋白质分解和肝糖原分解减少。
text_en: In this study, except for triglycerides, the total protein and albumin contents of crucian carp after anesthesia were lower than those in the control group, indicating that protein decomposition and liver glycogen decomposition in crucian carp decreased after anesthesia.
outcome: 代谢状态（蛋白质分解与肝糖原分解）

quote: An appropriate dose of anaesthetic reduces oxygen consumption and ammonia excretion, inhibits excessive stress in the fish, and effectively reduces injury, or mortality during handling.
statement: 适当剂量的麻醉剂可降低耗氧量和氨排泄量，抑制鱼类过度应激，并有效减少操作过程中的伤害或死亡率。
text_zh: 适当剂量的麻醉剂可降低耗氧量和氨排泄量，抑制鱼类过度应激，并有效减少操作过程中的伤害或死亡率。
text_en: Appropriate doses of anesthetics can reduce oxygen consumption and ammonia excretion, inhibit excessive stress in fish, and effectively reduce injury or mortality during handling.
outcome: 应激反应、耗氧量、氨排泄、操作损伤与死亡率

quote: Anaesthesia, with 40 mg/L MS-222 for 24 h, may cause some damage to the liver tissue of the Larimichthys crocea [ 50 ]
statement: 使用40 mg/L MS-222麻醉24小时可能对大黄鱼肝脏组织造成一定损害。
text_zh: 使用40 mg/L MS-222麻醉24小时可能对大黄鱼肝脏组织造成一定损害。
text_en: Anesthesia with 40 mg/L MS-222 for 24 hours may cause some damage to the liver tissue of large yellow croaker.

quote: deep anaesthesia of rainbow trout with Coriandrum sativum essential oil did not result in gill or liver damage [ 52 ]
statement: 使用芫荽精油对虹鳟进行深度麻醉未导致鳃或肝脏损伤。
text_zh: 使用芫荽精油对虹鳟进行深度麻醉未导致鳃或肝脏损伤。
text_en: Deep anesthesia of rainbow trout using coriander essential oil did not cause gill or liver damage.

quote: The control TP concentration of 76.33 ± 6.79 g/L decreased gradually with increasing vanillin treatment concentration to a minimum of 1.00 g/L vanillin, then gradually increased; the variation in ALB content was very similar to that of the TP content (Figure 5 A).
statement: 总蛋白（TP）浓度随香兰素处理浓度增加而逐渐降低，在1.00 g/L时达到最低值，随后逐渐升高；白蛋白（ALB）含量的变化趋势与TP非常相似。
text_zh: 总蛋白（TP）浓度随香兰素处理浓度增加而逐渐降低，在1.00 g/L时达到最低值，随后逐渐升高；白蛋白（ALB）含量的变化趋势与TP非常相似。
text_en: Total protein (TP) concentration gradually decreased with increasing vanillin treatment concentration, reaching the lowest value at 1.00 g/L, and then gradually increased; the change trend of albumin (ALB) content was very similar to that of TP.

quote: Taking market application as the starting point, the short average anaesthesia time is the focus of market demand, and it can be seen that the anaesthesia efficiency is higher when the test concentration is 0.50 g/L~1.50 g/L.
statement: 从市场应用的角度来看，较短的平均麻醉时间是市场需求的关键，可以看出当测试浓度为0.50 g/L至1.50 g/L时，麻醉效率更高。
text_zh: 从市场应用的角度来看，较短的平均麻醉时间是市场需求的关键，可以看出当测试浓度为0.50 g/L至1.50 g/L时，麻醉效率更高。
text_en: From the perspective of market application, a shorter average anesthesia time is key to market demand; it can be seen that when the test concentration is 0.50 g/L to 1.50 g/L, the anesthesia efficiency is higher.

quote: The timing and behavioural characteristics at each stage of anaesthesia (A 0 –A 4) and recovery (R 1 –R 4) of crucian carp were determined using 1.00 g/L vanillin (Table 3).
statement: 使用1.00 g/L的香兰素确定了鲫鱼在麻醉（A0–A4）和恢复（R1–R4）各阶段的时间和行为特征。
text_zh: 使用1.00 g/L的香兰素确定了鲫鱼在麻醉（A0–A4）和恢复（R1–R4）各阶段的时间和行为特征。
text_en: The time and behavioral characteristics of crucian carp at each stage of anesthesia (A0–A4) and recovery (R1–R4) were determined using 1.00 g/L vanillin.

quote: When a fish stopped swimming, completely lost the ability to respond, and the operculum opened weakly and slowly, it was defined as being at the A 3 stage of the anaesthesia period, and when the fish body was balanced and responsive, and the operculum opened normally, it was defined as being at the R 3 stage of recovery.
statement: 当鱼停止游泳、完全丧失反应能力且鳃盖微弱缓慢张开时，被定义为处于麻醉期的A3阶段；当鱼体平衡且有反应、鳃盖正常张开时，被定义为处于恢复期的R3阶段。
text_zh: 当鱼停止游泳、完全丧失反应能力且鳃盖微弱缓慢张开时，被定义为处于麻醉期的A3阶段；当鱼体平衡且有反应、鳃盖正常张开时，被定义为处于恢复期的R3阶段。
text_en: A fish is defined as being in stage A3 of the anesthesia period when it stops swimming, completely loses responsiveness, and its gill covers open weakly and slowly; a fish is defined as being in stage R3 of the recovery period when its body is balanced and responsive, and its gill covers open normally.

quote: The control WBC count was 809.76 ± 21.51 × 10 9 /L; the vanillin treatment WBC count initially markedly decreased, then slightly increased, with the increased vanillin concentration (Figure 2 A).
statement: 对照组的白细胞计数为809.76 ± 21.51 × 10^9/L；随着香兰素浓度的增加，香兰素处理组的白细胞计数先显著下降，然后略有上升。
text_zh: 对照组的白细胞计数为809.76 ± 21.51 × 10^9/L；随着香兰素浓度的增加，香兰素处理组的白细胞计数先显著下降，然后略有上升。
text_en: The white blood cell count in the control group was 809.76 ± 21.51 × 10^9/L; as the vanillin concentration increased, the white blood cell count in the vanillin-treated groups first decreased significantly and then rose slightly.

quote: The control RBC count was 0.17 ± 0.10 × 10 12 /L and markedly decreased at all vanillin treatment concentrations, with a minimum of 0.75 g/L (Figure 2 B).
statement: 对照组的红细胞计数为0.17 ± 0.10 × 10^12/L，在所有香兰素处理浓度下均显著下降，最低值出现在0.75 g/L。
text_zh: 对照组的红细胞计数为0.17 ± 0.10 × 10^12/L，在所有香兰素处理浓度下均显著下降，最低值出现在0.75 g/L。
text_en: The red blood cell count in the control group was 0.17 ± 0.10 × 10^12/L, and it decreased significantly at all vanillin treatment concentrations, with the lowest value occurring at 0.75 g/L.
counterevidence: 所有浓度下红细胞计数均显著下降

quote: The control HGB content was 95.11 ± 4.59 g/L and moderately decreased, then slightly increased, with increased vanillin treatment concentration (Figure 2 C).
statement: 对照组血红蛋白含量为95.11 ± 4.59 g/L，随着香兰素处理浓度的增加，先适度下降，然后略有上升。
text_zh: 对照组血红蛋白含量为95.11 ± 4.59 g/L，随着香兰素处理浓度的增加，先适度下降，然后略有上升。
text_en: The hemoglobin content in the control group was 95.11 ± 4.59 g/L; with increasing concentrations of vanillin treatment, it first decreased moderately and then rose slightly.

quote: For each antibiotic the inhibition zone (diameter in mm) was measured and expressed as susceptible, S (zone ≥ 21 mm); intermediate, I (zone = 16–20 mm); and resistance, R
statement: 对于每种抗生素，测量了抑菌圈直径（毫米），并将其表示为敏感（S，≥21 mm）、中介（I，16-20 mm）和耐药（R）。
text_zh: 对于每种抗生素，测量了抑菌圈直径（毫米），并将其表示为敏感（S，≥21 mm）、中介（I，16-20 mm）和耐药（R）。
text_en: For each antibiotic, the zone of inhibition diameter (mm) was measured and expressed as susceptible (S, ≥21 mm), intermediate (I, 16-20 mm), and resistant (R).

quote: The volume of water in each tank was 50 L, and the temperature was maintained at 25 °C.
statement: 每个水箱的水量为50升，温度维持在25°C。
text_zh: 每个水箱的水量为50升，温度维持在25°C。
text_en: The water volume in each tank is 50 liters, and the temperature is maintained at 25°C.

quote: Once acclimatized, the fish in the FiA2 group were fed with a normal diet containing the B. velezensis FiA2 strain (1 × 10 8 CFU/mL/gram), while the CK group diet contained sterilized 0.9% saline only.
statement: 驯化后，FiA2组的鱼喂食含有贝莱斯芽孢杆菌FiA2菌株的正常饲料，而CK组仅喂食含灭菌生理盐水的饲料。
text_zh: 驯化后，FiA2组的鱼喂食含有贝莱斯芽孢杆菌FiA2菌株的正常饲料，而CK组仅喂食含灭菌生理盐水的饲料。
text_en: After acclimation, fish in the FiA2 group were fed normal feed containing Bacillus velezensis strain FiA2, while the CK group was fed only feed containing sterilized physiological saline.

quote: In modern fish farming, high stocking densities and low water quality create the ideal environment for infections [ 1 ].
statement: 在现代鱼类养殖中，高放养密度和低水质为感染创造了理想环境。
text_zh: 在现代鱼类养殖中，高放养密度和低水质为感染创造了理想环境。
text_en: In modern fish farming, high stocking density and poor water quality create an ideal environment for infection.

quote: Bacterial infections such as Vibriosis, Streptococcosis, Columnaris, Edwardsiellosis, and Aeromonas septicemia have been reported as a major constraint in the development of aquaculture
statement: 弧菌病、链球菌病、柱状病、爱德华氏菌病和气单胞菌败血症等细菌感染被认为是水产养殖业发展的主要制约因素。
text_zh: 弧菌病、链球菌病、柱状病、爱德华氏菌病和气单胞菌败血症等细菌感染被认为是水产养殖业发展的主要制约因素。
text_en: Bacterial infections such as vibriosis, streptococcosis, columnaris disease, edwardsiellosis, and aeromonad septicemia are considered major constraints on the development of aquaculture.

quote: The infection results in muscular granuloma, skin ulceration, and necrosis in the liver, head kidney, spleen, and brain of the fish
statement: 该感染导致鱼类肌肉肉芽肿、皮肤溃疡以及肝脏、头肾、脾脏和脑部的坏死。
